Continuously develop your technical and professional skills while sharing knowledge and contributing to stronger engineering practices across teams. Strong understanding of software testing methodologies and a genuine commitment to delivering high-quality, reliable products. Practical experience with Behavior Driven Development (BDD), including Cucumber and Gherkin. Solid understanding of object-oriented programming, software engineering principles, and web technologies such as HTML and jQuery. Ability to write SQL queries for data validation and troubleshoot testing environments using Linux commands. Experience maintaining or working with test servers and an interest in infrastructure and cloud technologies. Strong interest in DevOps practices and CI/CD technologies such as Jenkins, Bamboo, or GitHub Actions. jobgether-jobgether:lever:28584582-2c7e-.title: Acquisitions Manager | Home Buying Specialist
jobgether-jobgether:lever:28584582-2c7e-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Acquisitions Manager | Home Buying Specialist based in Nigeria. This is a high-impact sales role at the heart of a fast-moving real estate acquisitions team. You’ll connect directly with property sellers, build trust, assess opportunities, and guide deals from initial conversation through closing. Your sales expertise will be central to negotiating attractive agreements while creating a positive experience for sellers. The role is designed for proven high-ticket sales professionals, including those transitioning into real estate from other industries. You’ll work closely with marketing and closing teams while staying informed on market trends and property values. With uncapped commission potential and structured onboarding support, the position rewards initiative, strong negotiation, and consistent performance. It’s a fully remote opportunity for an ambitious closer who wants significant ownership and earning potential. Engage with seller leads generated through marketing initiatives, building rapport and establishing trust throughout the sales process. Assess properties and gather relevant information to support accurate valuations and informed acquisition decisions. Lead negotiations with property sellers, applying strong sales and persuasion skills to structure mutually beneficial agreements. Manage deals from initial qualification through contract execution, ensuring a smooth transition to the closing team. Collaborate closely with marketing, acquisitions, and closing colleagues to keep transactions progressing efficiently. Maintain strong communication with sellers throughout the process, delivering a professional and memorable experience. Monitor real estate market conditions, trends, and relevant opportunities to strengthen competitiveness and decision-making. Build lasting relationships with sellers while consistently working toward acquisition, revenue, and performance targets. Requirements: At least 2 years of successful high-ticket sales experience , ideally within real estate, luxury goods, financial services, or another high-value sales environment. A proven track record of exceeding sales targets and consistently closing complex or high-value deals. Strong negotiation, objection-handling, and closing abilities, with confidence guiding prospects toward a decision. Excellent verbal and written communication skills, combined with a natural ability to establish rapport and build trusted relationships. Strong self-motivation and a results-oriented mindset, with the ability to work independently in a fast-paced, performance-driven environment. Comfortable using CRM platforms and modern sales technology to manage leads, follow-ups, and opportunities. Ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams while maintaining ownership of your deals. A real estate license is welcome but not required . Bilingual English/Spanish communication skills are a plus. Benefits: Base salary of approximately $2,000–$3,000 USD per month. Potential total earnings of up to approximately $8,000–$13,000 USD per month after commissions, depending on performance. 12.5% commission per deal with uncapped earning potential. Guaranteed salary during the first three months , providing stability while you transition into the role. Fully 100% remote position. Career growth opportunities within a performance-driven team. A supportive environment with training and tools designed to help successful sales professionals transition into real estate. Opportunity to build expertise in a dynamic and competitive property investment market. How Jobgether works: We use an AI-powered matching process to ensure your application is reviewed quickly, objectively, and fairly against the role's core requirements. Our system identifies the top-fitting candidates, and this shortlist is then shared directly with the hiring company.

jobgether-jobgether:lever:7e34ede5-9891-.title: Senior Creative Producer
jobgether-jobgether:lever:7e34ede5-9891-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Creative Producer based in Canada. This is a high-impact creative production role at the centre of a fast-moving performance marketing engine. You will turn creative ideas into a consistent, high-volume pipeline of compelling content, from creator-led UGC to polished productions. The role combines hands-on production management, creative quality control, talent coordination, budgeting, and process optimization. You will work closely with creative, growth, and strategy teams to transform briefs into realistic, market-ready production plans. You will also help build scalable systems that enable teams to test more ideas, learn faster, and amplify winning creative. Success requires exceptional organization, strong creative judgment, and the ability to balance speed, quality, compliance, and cost. This is an opportunity to shape how creative gets made in a collaborative, remote-first environment while contributing to a mission focused on improving access to everyday healthcare. Own the day-to-day creative production workflow, coordinating weekly project plans, daily schedules, sprint capacity, and deliverables from ideation through launch. Review creative concepts and outputs, performing quality control across scripts, edits, pacing, visual execution, brand alignment, and advertising-platform requirements. Build, manage, and grow a creator and UGC network, including recruiting, onboarding, coordinating, briefing, and maintaining an organized library of raw footage and reusable assets. Manage relationships with creators, actors, photographers, videographers, production assistants, and other suppliers, including rate negotiations, statements of work, availability, and talent rosters. Manage production budgets and contribute to forecasting across talent, locations, vendors, props, wardrobe, and other production needs while identifying opportunities to improve efficiency. Partner with creative leadership, growth, and strategy teams to translate the creative calendar into achievable production plans, providing clear guidance on capacity, timelines, dependencies, and feasibility. Convert creative briefs into practical production materials, including shot lists, call sheets, timelines, deliverable checklists, and production plans for both creator-first and polished content. Source locations, props, wardrobe, and other production requirements, and oversee production days when needed. Own production compliance by securing usage rights, model releases, and required documentation, while ensuring creative adheres to applicable Canadian health-advertising requirements and restrictions on claims and imagery. Capture and communicate production learnings by connecting deliverables to concepts, facilitating post-production feedback, and identifying what is performing well and where creative iteration is needed. Develop scalable production systems, workflows, documentation, and processes that increase creative output while reducing bottlenecks, complexity, and unnecessary costs. Use AI tools throughout the production process to test creative directions efficiently, remix and version assets at scale, and improve production workflows. Requirements 5+ years of experience in creative project management, production, creative operations, or a related field, including responsibility for production budgets. Demonstrated success improving creative processes within a growth-stage or fast-paced environment, with measurable examples of efficiency or workflow improvements. Experience building or managing creator, UGC, or content production pipelines at scale, with confidence working across both lo-fi, creator-first content and polished productions. Strong understanding of performance marketing and how creative production supports testing, optimization, and growth. Fluency with AI-assisted creative production, including using AI
